name: IconTile
summary: An icon on a liquid-metal tile; always decorative, the text beside it carries the meaning.

guidance.useFor: Beside a heading in a feature grid, in a wordmark, or large in a hero or media frame.
insteadUse: An icon that means something on its own: Icon with a label
content: Pick an icon that echoes the words beside it; never rely on it alone

rungReason: A <span> with aria-hidden holding an inline SVG; the metal is CSS.

keyboard.action: Passes over it: nothing here takes focus

rules: Always aria-hidden; never the only way something is said
forcedColors: Canvas with a CanvasText border; the icon in CanvasText
